name: home-frame-1-cabinet
refs: The signed day vivarium (project-owned): THE living vivarium to paint in the centre pane: its moss, stones, roots, burrow, pool and warm daylight from the top left, in its painted matte style.

The version 4 Loikas (project-owned): the dark charcoal creature with a leaf crest, orange eyes with cream rings and a cream belly, in its russet, ash and charcoal coats, with pale patches or stripes: the residents of the vivarium.
The S03 founder (project-owned): the young teal creature with round ears, a thin antenna crest, big eyes, pale mint body with teal spots, a tail with a small yellow bulb.
A pod (project-owned): the dark speckled egg-like pod with a pale lid, a small quiet painted object for the left column.
prompt: Paint ONE finished 'inspiration frame' of a calm always-on home screen, widescreen, in the soft sculpted, painterly Miniature Lives style (matte, tactile, warm). The whole picture is one calm, matte, dark slate face with soft rounded panes set in it: NO bezels, NO lamps, NO glowing edges, no frame. One warm daylight from the top left on everything; the living things carry the colour, the device itself stays quiet. LAYOUT: in the CENTRE, the largest pane, the living vivarium: the same moss floor, stones, roots, burrow mound and pool as the first reference, with three or four of the Loikas from the second reference standing on the moss (russet, ash and charcoal ones, some with pale patches or stripes). On the RIGHT, about one third of the picture's width, the Library pane, described below. On the LEFT, a narrow quiet column of four small painted objects, top to bottom in this order: a pod (like the fourth reference), a small egg-incubator chamber, a small cargo bay crate, and a small handheld companion device; each sits in its own small soft rounded slate recess, with a tiny plain label under it reading exactly: Pods, Incubator, Bay, Companion. These four are small and quiet. NEVER: any other text, holograms, neon, chrome, glowing outlines, cream panels, anything red, hands, people. THE LIBRARY PANE: a naturalist's glass-fronted wooden specimen cabinet set into the slate. Behind the glass sits ONE open botanical specimen plate for the Loika on warm, aged, slightly tea-toned botanical paper (never bright cream): the Loika's portrait at the centre, and around it its traits as delicate painted sprigs. The traits already found (a leaf crest, pale patches, stripes, eye rings) are small, fully painted specimens, pinned to the plate and lit by the daylight; the traits not yet found are only faint graphite pencil outlines on the plate, a soft mystery waiting to be filled. Below the plate a slim drawer is half open, holding small framed portraits of the player's own Loikas joined by fine painted threads, like a family tree.
